title: gtrack editor: new gnaural-track editor on one form with wave + spectrum

decisions.text: New editor beside the old one (2026-07-08). New GTrack* components; GnauralEditorPanel/GnauralScheduleView untouched. Reuse: GnauralScheduleData protocol model, dump-schedule, gnaural-editor-store (save+validate), spectrogram-audio-source render bridge, SF-D66 unified track stack.

Host = Audio tab shared stack (owner choice 2026-07-08). gtrack lanes are kind:'gtrack' in the unified track model; shared time view/zoom/pan/minimap/resizers/eye/drag/gear. Lanes appear only when a .gnaural is open.
Wave/spectrum beside gtracks = gnaural render -> WAV (owner choice 2026-07-08), via the existing spectrogram-audio-source mechanism. After Save: invalidate analysis + re-render (button; auto later).

Editing = in-memory model + Save (owner choice 2026-07-08). Reactive editable copy, undo/redo in memory, dirty flag, Save (button + Ctrl+S) writes through the existing store with Gnaural.exe validation.

Save = surgical XML patch (owner 2026-07-08; refined at GT1.2). The patcher replaces ONLY each edited voice's <entries> block (matched by <id>) with per-point <entry> nodes and leaves every other byte untouched (comments, file/voice metadata, unknown fields, untouched voices survive). Generator ('preparse') voices are baked into concrete entries on save - the only way to persist hand edits. Pure string transform (no DOM), runs in the browser Save path and under bun. Round-trip through Gnaural.exe --dump-schedule is the GT1.2 gate. Mapping: M XML entries <-> M dump segments <-> M+1 model points; entry k value from P_k, duration from P_{k+1}.time-P_k.time; XML beatfreq = 2*beatFreqHalf; last point supplies only the final (flat-tail) duration.
Derived axes: Beat freq displayed as 2x beatFreqHalf; Volume=(volL+volR)/2; Stereo balance derived from volL/volR; editing Volume/Balance maps back to volL/volR (mono: volL only).
Wave<->XML synchronization is Phase 5: design discussion with the owner first, code only after a separate go.

Add/remove nodes (owner req. 9, 2026-07-08). Model gains insertPoint (at a click time; values interpolated from the surrounding segment) and removePoint (transactional, undo/redo). Invariants: time stays monotonic; a voice cannot drop below 1 segment (>=2 points). The GT-D5 patcher already regenerates the whole <entries> block from points, so changing the point count serializes with no extra work. UI in Phase 3 (double-click add; Delete/context-menu remove).

Prepared nodes: distinction + fixing (owner req. 10-11, 2026-07-08). Verified: --dump-schedule EXPANDS <entry type="preparse"> into concrete points (circle.gnaural -> 60 entries / 61 points per voice), but the source XML keeps one generator node and the dump does not flag provenance. So preparse voices are identified by parsing the source XML (ids whose <entries> contain type="preparse"); those points are marked preparse:true. (10) Render preparse points distinctly (e.g. hollow/dashed markers) + a 'generated' lane badge. (11) An explicit per-voice 'Fix / make editable' action clears the flag (in-memory bake of the expansion) so points become editable; unfixed preparse points are locked from direct editing (attempting it offers to fix). On Save a fixed voice writes concrete entries (already GT-D5). Fixing is irreversible within the file (loses the generator) -> warn the user; never auto-fix.

Tracks tab + frozen old tabs (owner req. 12, Q&A 2026-07-08; all three recommendations accepted). Variant 1 'frozen copy': (a) TracksPanel.vue = MOVE of the current stack (wave+spectrum+minimap+gtracks+SF25-28 chrome/dialogs) out of AudioPage into a new 'Tracks' sub-tab right of 'Spectrogram'; (b) the Spectrogram tab in AudioPage is RESTORED from git to the pre-GT2.2 state (GnauralCore 6c0589c) - exactly the accepted code, no gtracks; Playback untouched. Direction: old code from git, current code (old+new) moves to TracksPanel - no re-writing new features onto an old copy. Scope: Tracks works for ALL audio files (gtracks only for .gnaural) and is the single surface for all future work (Phase 3+). Isolation: fully separate state - own spectrogramShared (zoom/selection) and NEW localStorage keys; no cross-tab influence. Cost: deliberate duplication (~400 template lines + logic); fixes go ONLY to Tracks; frozen tabs are deleted after Tracks stabilizes (a future step).

Audio file-cache management (owner req. 13, 2026-07-09). Server caches gnaural->WAV renders (tmp/audio-render, incl. the new single-loop spectrogram variant) + conversions (tmp/audio-convert). Cache key = sha1(path+size+mtime+kind+discriminator) -> no reverse cache->source map, so a MANIFEST is needed (record {cacheFile, sourcePath, kind, discriminator, bytes, createdAt} on write). UI: total size, per-source list with variants + sizes, delete entry / clear all, via GET/DELETE /api/audio/cache. Orphan files (no manifest) shown as 'unknown source'. Steps GT6.1 (manifest+endpoints), GT6.2 (UI).

Thin client: retire the client-side WAV decode (owner req. 14, 2026-07-09). decodeAudioData -> spectrogramBuffer is legacy from before variant A. Tiles (get-tile) + waveform peaks (get-peaks) are already backend. The buffer is used only for: the spectrogram OVERLAY waveform (still client-computed via useAudioModel(waveformBuffer)), source channelCount, and duration (backend already returns durationSec). The singleLoop cap (GT2.6) was a symptom fix. Proper: metadata + overlay from the backend, drop the client decode. Tracks tab only (frozen tabs keep the store decode until they're deleted). The worker already knows WavInfo.Channels but doesn't expose it. Steps GT7.1 (channelCount in worker/protocol/server + single-loop backend gnaural analysis), GT7.2 (Tracks metadata from backend, drop ensureGnauralSpectrogram), GT7.3 (overlay via get-peaks), GT7.4 (cleanup).

Gtrack lanes = a schedule editor like the classic one (owner 2026-07-09, screenshots). Model: (1) default ONE VOICE -> ONE LANE (classic per-voice tracks); tonal opens on Base freq, noise/audiofile on Volume; (2) merging voices into one lane = user's choice (gear checkboxes, already supported); (3) modes Base/Beat/Volume/Balance per lane as planned; (4) one voice may appear in several lanes with different parameters (add lane + gear, already supported). Rendering matches the classic editor: Base freq on a LOG axis (same log10 mapping as GnauralScheduleView, default log there), Volume as filled envelopes. The lane architecture (resize/hide/reorder/point-edit) stays.

One graph type per lane (owner req. 15, CORRECTED 2026-07-09): 'type' means the parameter type base/beat/volume/balance, NOT voice.type. Already guaranteed by construction - a lane has exactly one mode, so curves in a lane are always one type; multiple voices allowed. No guard needed; GT3.8 closed by design.

Schedule block + SLIDE-OVER voice panel (owner req. 16+20, corrected: the panel slides OVER the tracks, overlay-left, SF3.1 pattern). Panel: every voice (name/type/colour), graph-type switch, visibility toggle; bulk actions (req 20): merge-all-into-one-lane, spread-per-voice, 'all in mode X' selector, hide/show all, reset-default-layout; plus editor properties (point-drag mode, GT-D16). Mapping: voice visibility = hidden of all lanes containing it (toggle-on with no lane creates one); graph-type change = mode change of all lanes containing the voice.

Cross-graph point sync + TWO drag modes (owner req. 17-19, corrected). Invariant: GTrackModel is the single source, every lane renders the same voice points, so move (17) and delete (19) sync automatically - lock with tests. (18) Point drag is a PERSISTED EDITOR SETTING with two modes: 'clamp' (within neighbours) and 'crossover' (past a neighbour: stable time re-sort, drag follows the same point under its new index, selection updates). Undo = one unit per drag in both modes.

Per-lane solo spectrum/waveform of the lane's voice set (owner req. 21, 2026-07-09). The server renders a temp schedule copy with all OTHER voices muted (+<loops>1</loops>, same trick as single-loop) -> WAV -> the existing analysis pipeline (tiles/peaks) -> an underlay in the lane beneath the curves. Cache key gains the voice-id set (GT-D11 manifest tracks variants). Per-lane gear setting: off/wave/spectrum/both. Phase 4 (GT4.3), generalizes GT4.2.

Non-modal live point INSPECTOR (owner reqs 25-32, 2026-07-10). The point dialog becomes an inspector: seamless/non-modal (no backdrop, page stays interactive, user closes it), FOLLOWS the selection (clicking another node shows it), LIVE-updates while a point is dragged (values from the model), an 'Autosave' checkbox (field changes apply immediately; otherwise the Apply button), 'Delete node' and 'Add node to the right' buttons (insert into the middle of the next segment, interpolated). Multi-select: Ctrl/Shift+click accumulates nodes (selection becomes a list) -> the inspector auto-switches to a TABLE mode (row = node, editable cells). Editor tools (req 24): in point mode, toggleable 'Add node' (click on curve) and 'Delete node' (click on node) cursor tools complement dblclick/Delete. Node hover shows a tooltip with its characteristics (req 25).

Per-lane spectrum settings, via the lane gear, as an accordion (owner reqs 35-37, 2026-07-10). Today the spectrogram analysis/display parameters live in a single global panel for the whole tab. Owner wants: (35) invoke from the specific spectrum lane's gear (the same right-side gear chrome as every other lane, SF-D66), not a shared place; (36) INDEPENDENT settings per spectrogram instance (a lane may host several spectra - e.g. the GT-D17 solo set - each with its own FFT size/window/scale/colormap/gain/range); (37) the panel itself is an ACCORDION (collapsible sections Analysis / Display+colour / Range / ...). Implementation: lift the current global spectrum-settings state into a per-lane/per-instance config (key = laneId/spectrum-instance-id, default inherited from the current global), persist per file; re-skin the settings dialog as q-expansion-item sections and open it from the gear of the lane owning that instance. Frozen old tabs untouched (Tracks only). New Phase 8 (GT8.1 per-lane+gear, GT8.2 accordion).

Visually group a voice's lanes + 'show all modes per voice' (owner req. 38, 2026-07-10). A button in the voices panel: 'Show all modes for each voice' mass-spreads every parameter (base/beat/volume/balance) across lanes for each voice (generalizes the GT-D15 bulk spread / all-in-mode). Lanes belonging to one voice are grouped visually. Styling variants (proposed, owner picks): (a) LEFT COLOUR STRIPE on the lane in the voice colour (thin accent border at the left edge) - recommended: least noise, distinguishes multiple voices, reuses the existing per-voice colour; (b) shared background tint (voice colour, translucent) - more obvious but noisier on the canvas; (c) lane title in the voice colour - cheap but weak at small text; (d) a group bracket/badge on the left joining adjacent same-voice lanes - clearest but needs the voice's lanes to be contiguous. OWNER CHOICE (2026-07-10): (a) left stripe + (c) coloured title. (d) optional if lanes are sorted by voice after the spread. GT3.18 implements a+c.
